categories.name: AI Safety & Multi-Agent Systems
categories.summary: Research focus on improving security protocols for multi-agent AI systems, particularly addressing data protection and harm mitigation. The Google A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocol is under scrutiny for potential vulnerabilities when agents exchange sensitive information.

key_items.title: Google A2A Protocol Security Improvements Proposed
key_items.detail: New research paper examines methods to protect sensitive data and mitigate unintended harms in multi-agent systems using Google's A2A protocol framework.

categories.name: Security Tools & Releases
categories.summary: New tooling emerging for detecting and monitoring shadow AI deployments within organizations. EchelonGraph has released a Shadow AI Radar tool aimed at identifying unauthorized or unmonitored AI systems in enterprise environments.

key_items.title: Shadow AI Radar Tool by EchelonGraph
key_items.detail: A new monitoring tool designed to detect shadow AI deployments—unauthorized AI systems operating within organizations that may pose security and compliance risks.

top_insights: Multi-agent AI security is gaining research attention, with protocol-level protections becoming a priority as agent-to-agent communication expands.
Shadow AI—unauthorized AI deployments within organizations—is emerging as a recognized threat vector requiring dedicated detection tooling.
The intersection of AI orchestration protocols and data protection represents a growing research frontier for enterprise security.
